newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-150 MLN KROONS INVESTED IN TALLINN HOTELS - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-150 MLN KROONS INVESTED IN TALLINN HOTELS - REPORT.

text.p: Over 150 million kroons is currently being put into renovations of Estonian hotels this year, Aripaev business daily said on Tuesday.
Investments into the capital's hotels cover complete construction to major renovations and improving the quality of the facilities.

The largest investment of 60 million kroons is into the Park Hotel, formally the Kungla, for a complete renovation, followed by the Olumpia with 50 million kroons for renewing the facade, the newspaper added.
According to data from the state tourism board, investments in hotels and catering in 1993 to 1996 was 650 million kroons the paper added.
